reviews.title: Not as good as it used to be.
reviews.text:
Was a really good app for many years. Had a very clean interface and nicely organized weather information you could bring up very quickly. 
Now it’s just a cluttered mess.

reviews.title: Not a nice app anymore
reviews.text: Not liking this new version at all, not user friendly like the old one which was the only one I liked. Please bring back the old one, much better layout

reviews.title: The recent “improvements” have ruined it for me.
reviews.text: I loved this app as much for the  animated views of earth as for the weather information. The app is now so cluttered (especially on the iPhone) that I cringe whenever I use it. The  uniqueness has been lost, and the beauty of the living earth has been traded for a redesign that hardly differs from that of any other weather app.

reviews.title: UI Update - Not for me
reviews.text: The pictured UI for the app is the old UI. It is was simple and expanded vertically to show two hour forecast blocks. Their new UI looks like every other weather app, busy with too much going on and not what I want. The earth part is still pretty, but it’s not the app I paid for…

reviews.title: Not working when window is resized
reviews.text: This new release is still not working when resizing the window.  Please roll back to a working release

reviews.title: HATE 5/2026 update
reviews.text:
Loved this app until the last update…harder to quickly check up weather for the week or day… very disappointed…actually, disgusted with the new update!!
I wouldn’t have any other weather app before, but now looking for a different one.

reviews.title: Horrible Update
reviews.text:
App looked awesome before - nice and simple. Now they just copied Apple weather’s design - too much unnecessary info.

Add feature for Classic design.

reviews.title: Used to love it
reviews.text: Not sure why, but they ruined a great app with their most recent upgrade. Layout is now cluttered, and busy, and requires scrolling when it used to deliver a lot of information at a glance. I can no longer recommend this app. Looking for a new one that will provide more complete information at a glance.

reviews.title: LOVED until 4.20
reviews.text:
First, why wasn’t 4.20 numbered as 5.0 - the UI was rewritten (and poorly!)

Issues w/ 4.20 revamp:

- Detail weather page has redundant current condition e.g. “Scattered thunderstorms” AND “Thunderstorms and Rain”. Wasted screen space!
- Now have to scroll past new *horizontal* hourly fcst to view daily fcst
- Hourly fcsts are now HORIZONTAL… DISLIKE! I originally *BOUGHT* LE since it still had VERTICALLY expanding fcst layout. Most other weather apps have horizontal layout (or switched from vertical to horizontal) which makes no sense as phones are held VERTICALLY by default!
- Daily high/low temps have switched positions … why make change just for the sake of change?
- While viewing daily fcst detail, after scrolling the hourly section to right, then changing to next or previous day via left/right arrow, the subsequently-selected day’s hourly fcst remains in same position as prior day, rather than resetting to left-most time (12 AM)
- New layout junk wasn’t updated in App Store nor dev’s website. Perhaps bring back the prior/better layout, or add option for preferred layout…??
- Several items differ between pre-4.20 and 4.20:  High/low daily temps, Humidity, wind speed, Sunrise/Sunset times. Seriously?

I will NOT update LE to 4.20 on main phone. Thankfully I tested it on old phone first!

reviews.title: Not a wallpaper
reviews.text: I need a wallpaper for time & weather - this is beautiful but not functional.

reviews.title: Not there when needed
reviews.text: This app is regularly unavailable, showing full blanks like it is offline.

reviews.title: Pretty BUT worthless for an accurate forecast
reviews.text: I always first go to this app because I love the picture of the Earth and how easy it is to navigate and add cities. For all of the years I’ve been using it, the one thing I can count on is it’s never right. I also use the weather channel and it’s crazy how different it always is. For example, Living Earth shows the next 7 days in Denver Colorado to have a 50% chance of rain/snow. The news, the weather channel and everything else says zero precipitation for the next 10 days. I’m sure Living Earth, as usual, will be the one that’s wrong.🤷🏼‍♀️

reviews.title: Unable to load any more
reviews.text:
Dear Author,

I wasn’t able contact you through the App Support link and so I have to use this as my method of communication.

I am one of your happy customers up to my transfer to iPhone 17 Pro using iOS 26.3. Now I cannot load your app either from my iTunes account or your page. There is no error message. I have done shutdown and restarted and cleared my caches. Since the app is not on the phone I can’t erase it and reload. 

This has happened to at least 30 other applications from a variety of authors. There was some change in iOS 26.3 that is interfering with loading. Would you please create an update to fix it so I can use your app again?

Best Wishes, Eve

reviews.title: Severely Declined In Quality
reviews.text: When Living earth first came out it had accurate weather forecasts, a little temperature badge that you can see from the main screen, and it was aesthetically pleasing to look at with a view of Earth from space. When it was working this app became a favorite, however I found that this app has severely declined over the last few years. The weather is no longer accurate, the temperature badge is gone, even the animation of the Earth malfunctions on a new iPhone 16 Pro. I am extremely disappointed in the product and cannot recommend this app to anyone.
